question_evaluation.subject: Craftsouth: Centre For Contemporary Craft & Design Inc
question_evaluation.question: What does it say it does?
question_evaluation.answer: 2025 was a year defined by artistic excellence, collective achievement and renewed purpose for Guildhouse. Guided by our new Strategic Plan and Manifesto, we stepped forward with conviction as sector leaders supporting the career development and livelihoods of South Australian artists at  every stage of their career.  Our suite of nationally recognised artistic programs continued to advance practice, encourage experimentation and increase visibility for visual artists, craft makers and designers. Whilst our unique exhibition series, in traditional and non-traditional gallery spaces, connected South Australian artists and their work to new  audiences of over 2 million people.  In 2025 Guildhouse provided an ambitious suite of tailored support services and meaningful employment for artists, generating more than $1.2 million in direct income for artists, artisans and creative  workers.

question_evaluation.answer: Our charity s programs are dedicated to rescuing and supporting animals while assisting vulnerable members of our community. Through our foster program, we rescue, rehabilitate, and rehome special needs animals that might otherwise face euthanasia. Our mobile vet clinic provides fear-free, tailored veterinary care, particularly for anxious pets, helping guardians keep and care for their animals rather than surrendering them due to behavioural challenges. Additionally, our outreach programs support those in crisis, including terminally ill individuals, people at risk of homelessness, women escaping domestic violence, and communities affected by natural disasters, ensuring pets remain with their families during difficult times.

comparative_findings.progressive_card_wins: Fast identity/work/finance answers where a small set of atomic records exists, while source locators remain one click away.
comparative_findings.dossier_wins: Financial interpretation needs adjacent statement rows, comparative values and statement title; dossier is also the honest place to show 20-section coverage.
comparative_findings.baseline_ais_wins: For simple regulator totals it is equivalent; the ledger adds review-unit IDs, explicit candidate status and cross-source portability rather than new facts.
comparative_findings.latent_vs_visible: Visible: identity, reported purpose/programs, workforce, totals and disclosed financial rows. Latent/not established: partners, beneficiary reach, outcomes, current capacity, governance quality, values and most dossier sections.
trust_failures: A related-party Yes/No must not appear as a propriety judgement.
A purpose description must not appear as measured impact.
A visible financial line without statement title/comparative context invites misleading ratios.
Coverage-only cards must lead with unavailable representation, not a blank optimistic card.
product_changes_implied: Make candidate/reported status and reporting period persistent on every visible answer.
Put coverage gaps beside each card section, with an abstain response as a first-class result.
Use progressive card as default; open the dossier for financial context, conflicts, and breadth inspection.
Keep provenance IDs and locators copyable at answer level; do not require a user to infer their source.
